title: 芯片中转传言五年：他说早不新鲜，东南亚云渠道要变？
speaker: Mehran Gul

segments.en: I think beyond the U.S. in China, this has implications for the wider ASEAN region as well.
segments.zh: 我认为除了美国和中国，这对更广泛的东盟地区也有影响。

segments.en: Rumors about Singapore or Indonesia or Malaysia being a wave station for NVIDIA chips into China have been around for at least five years now.
segments.zh: 关于新加坡、印尼或马来西亚是英伟达芯片进入中国的中转站的传言，至少已经流传五年了。

segments.en: And companies like Megaspeed and other companies, I mean, Megaspeed rumors have been around for over a year.
segments.zh: 像Megaspeed这样的公司，以及其他公司，我是说，Megaspeed的传言已经流传一年多了。

segments.en: And the company has been denying these rumors for over a year at this point in time.
segments.zh: 而该公司一年多来一直在否认这些传言。

segments.en: So Megaspeed being at the middle of this is not news.
segments.zh: 所以Megaspeed处于此事中心并不新鲜。

segments.en: We've been hearing about this for a while. So I think data centers coming up in the Southeast Asian region were premised on the notion
segments.zh: 我们对此已经有所耳闻。我认为东南亚地区的数据中心是基于这样一个前提：

segments.en: that Chinese companies can access NVIDIA resources over the cloud.
segments.zh: 中国公司可以通过云访问英伟达资源。

segments.en: And this will potentially turn off the tap to that as well.
segments.zh: 而这可能会切断这一渠道。

segments.en: There's Kim Eris Mirana, and then there's Jensen Huang.
segments.zh: 有Kim Eris Mirana，还有黄仁勋。

segments.en: I mean, he's so pivotal in this whole AI story and everything that's around him, whether it's the financing of data centers or neo-clouds,
segments.zh: 我是说，他在整个人工智能故事以及周围的一切中如此关键，无论是数据中心的融资还是新型云服务，

segments.en: whether it's really just being part of this whole AI supply chain, if his position would be in fact compromised in some way,
segments.zh: 是否真的只是参与整个AI供应链的一部分，他的处境是否会因此受到某种影响，

segments.en: how significant would that be, if you think?
segments.zh: 如果这样，影响会有多严重？

segments.en: I think the fact that he was at the center of such a high profile targeting effort shows you just how important he is, not just to global compute, but bilateral relations between the US and China.
segments.zh: 我认为，他处于如此高调的目标行动中心，恰恰说明他不仅对全球计算至关重要，对美中双边关系也同样重要。

segments.en: I think in the past, you would not have seen such a high profile attempt to ensnare a senior business leader.
segments.zh: 我认为过去你不会看到如此高调地试图针对一位资深商业领袖。

segments.en: This sort of targeting would potentially have happened only for senior political leaders.
segments.zh: 这种针对行动可能只会发生在高级政治领导人身上。

segments.en: So I think it's very significant.
segments.zh: 所以我认为这非常值得关注。
